What is Parkstack? Parkstack helps small attractions build their own website and keep it up to date themselves. You get a proper website for your park, showing what there is to do, when you’re open, where to eat and how to find you, and you change it whenever something changes. When you’re ready, you can sell tickets on it too. Who is it for? Small and family-run attractions: amusement parks, fairgrounds, farm parks, petting zoos, play centres, small museums and anywhere else people visit for a fun day out.
